verdict.rationale: Goodwin has a dedicated Patent Prosecution + Counseling practice page drawing on more than 100 IP specialists, covering procuring patent rights and proactive counsel on others' patent rights. That satisfies the documented group-page requirement for patent prosecution. Its IP litigation team's PTAB work adds some support for building a defensible patent position. missing for 10: named patent practitioners, explicit detail on drafting and filing applications, documented patent portfolio-strategy offerings, independent corroboration.
